Home.heroTitle: Farm machines, right when you need them
Home.heroText: Tractor, harvester, pump and more — with a trained operator, at a price inside government limits.
Home.step1Text: Pick the work, the date and your field on the map.
Home.step2Text: See the full price before you book. No hidden cost.
Home.step3Text: The operator starts and finishes the job with your secret code (OTP).
Home.step4Text: Pay online or in cash and get a receipt.

Dashboard.featuresNote: These features are being added step by step.

FARMER: Search machines on a map and by work type
See the price before booking and book in 3 steps
Track your booking and share the start/finish code
Pay online or in cash and download the receipt
Review the machine and the operator
COOP_LEADER: Create your cooperative and add member farmers
Book one machine for many members' plots in a village
PROVIDER: Set your rate inside government limits
Block days on the availability calendar
Add operators and assign them to jobs
See earnings, payouts and service alerts
OPERATOR: See today's jobs with map and farmer's phone
Update status: On the way → Arrived → Start → Finish
Start and finish jobs with the farmer's OTP
Report a breakdown with a photo
TECHNICIAN: Update status: Received → Inspecting → Repairing → Fixed
Mark the machine fit for work
OFFICER: See bookings and complaints in your upazila
GOVT: Set price limits for each machine type
See reports: bookings by district, demand vs supply, prices
ADMIN: Decide disputes and answer support tickets
Change settings and read the audit log
